The margin estimate uses a linear transformation of EPA to project game outcomes, while the efficiency ratio compares offensive performance between teams. Pressure dynamics quantify defensive aggression. These operators exhibit duality in their interpretation: margin estimate and efficiency ratio reflect offensive and defensive balance, whereas pressure dynamics indicate risk exposure.
